SignalsLink.YTT
Connects the Freight Dock and Chunk Anchor with trains from the Yang's Transport Tycoon mod.

Loading and unloading trains
Write a header with the word train on the Freight Dock paper:
unload train — from the train to the Freight Dock crate
load train — from the crate to the train
from train to yard — directly from the train to the storage yard
from yard to train — from the storage yard to the train
Write rules below the header as with other devices; see Paper conditions.
The train must be stopped. It is searched for up to 12 blocks from the Freight Dock, and loading starts with the nearest car.

Options after the word train
You can combine words; their order does not matter.
north, south, east, west — only the train on that side. n, s, e, w also work.
north5 — only the train stopped five blocks to the north. The number can be 1 to 12.
2 — only the second vehicle of the consist, counted from the front.
boxcar — only boxcars.
fridge — only refrigerated cars.
cart — only minecarts.
fridge 2 — the second refrigerated car from the front. With a car type, the number is counted only among cars of that type.
engine — fuel and water for the steam engine.
ice — refrigerated car cooling slots, i.e. space for ice.
Without the word engine, nothing is loaded into the firebox. Without the word ice, ice goes into the cargo compartment like any other goods.

Examples
unload train north
load train boxcar
load train fridge 2 south
load train engine
load train ice

Chunk Anchor
The Anchor dialog gains a Wake when a train approaches toggle. A sleeping Anchor will then wake up as soon as a train is heading to its station, even if it is traveling out of players' sight.
As long as a train is standing in the Anchor's area, the Anchor also keeps the columns beneath its cars loaded and does not go to sleep.
The column selection must cover the entire stopped train, not just the station.
Without this mod, Anchors are disabled on a server with Yang's Transport Tycoon.

For server administrators
On startup, the mod checks whether it understands the installed version of Yang's Transport Tycoon. If not, it disables train loading and writes this to the log.
The AnchorApproachBlocks option in the signalslink.json file determines how far before the station the Anchor wakes up.
The /slytt dump command prints the status of all consists to the server log. With a number, for example /slytt dump 64, only those within that many blocks of you.
